title: MineRooms - Backrooms Blocks
description: Re-styles multiple blocks to Backrooms-themed blocks for map building.
body:
MineRooms - Backrooms Blocks is a simple pack that replaces some of the Minecraft blocks into Backrooms-themed blocks to use in maps and builds. This pack is expecially useful for map builders, or just the people who want to build their own Backrooms.

![Mod Title and Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d8be3a0b2874208b6e4a5c5556b0c295c421c82_0.webp)

So far, these are the textures avaliable:

    Level 0 Carpet (Yellow Wool)
    Level 0 Walls (Bamboo and Birch Wood Set)
    Level 0 Walls with Trims
    Level 0 Walls with Surfaces
    Level 0 Tiles (Polished Diorite Set)
    Office Tiles (Polished Granite Set
    Flickering Fluorescent Light (Sea Lantern)
    Blank Walls (Birch Planks)
    Blank Walls with Blue Tape Door (Stripped Bamboo and Bamboo)
    Level 0 Walls with Blue Tape Door (Bamboo Planks and Bamboo Mosaic)
    Vents (Iron Trapdoor)
    Flurocent Sky Light (Ochre Froglight)
    And more to come in next secret update 🤫


🔊 SPREAD AWARENESS: Resource pack/mod scraping sites are illegially hosting other people's resource packs and mods without their permission. These copied pages are very hard to remove, and take away direct support from the creators. To learn more about these sites, visit StopModReposts.org
